newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ's Bolger confers with senior ministers.
newsitem.headline: NZ's Bolger confers with senior ministers.

text.p: New Zealand caretaker Prime Minister Jim Bolger was conferring with senior ministers and members of his negotiating team on Tuesday as he awaited word from the New Zealand First caucus meeting.
Justice Minister Doug Graham, Finance Minister Bill Birch, Foreign Minister Don McKinnon and senior backbencher Max Bradford were all seen entering Bolger's office.
Both National and Labour said there was no word from NZ First on its deliberations to choose a coalition partner.
